scenes.title: Interrogation Room — Raat Ki Baarish
narration: *Concrete interrogation room ki thandi deewaron par flickering tube light ki safed roshni kaanp rahi hai. Bahar bhaari toofan hai aur tez baarish building ke sheeshon se takra rahi hai.*

*Metal table ke us paar DCP Maaya khadi hai. Uske samne transparent evidence pouch mein woh rare, limited-edition watch aur case ke saboot rakhe hain. Maaya ki tez, shant nazar seedhi us ghadi par tiki hai.*
Maaya: "Serial number jhooth nahi ho sakta."
Maaya: "Lekin ab tum is serial killing case ke prime suspect ho."
*Kamre mein ek gehra, tanav bhara sannata chha jaata hai. Tube light ek baar phir jhilmilati hai, aur Maaya table par halka sa jhuk kar tumhari aankhon mein dekhti hai.*
Maaya: "Ye watch waqai chori hui thi."
Maaya: "Ya tum mujhe bewakoof bana rahe ho?"
fallbackLines: *Flickering tube light ke neeche DCP Maaya ki nazar tumhare chehre aur table par rakhi limited-edition watch ke beech tiki rehti hai.*
Maaya: "Main sun rahi hoon, {{playerName}}. Jo bhi kehna hai, saboot aur timeline ke saath kaho."

choices.text: "Meri watch kuch din pehle gayab ho gayi thi — main sach keh raha hoon."

memory: {{playerName}} stated in interrogation that his rare limited-edition watch disappeared several days ago.

choices.text: "Mujhe batao ye watch crime scene par kis haalat mein aur kahan mili?"

memory: {{playerName}} asked DCP Maaya for the exact crime-scene recovery details of the watch.

choices.text: "Mera crime scenes par jaana mera forensic kaam hai — agar mujhe maarna hota toh apni serial number wali ghadi wahan kyun chhodta?"

memory: {{playerName}} challenged Maaya to consider why a forensic photographer would leave his own serialized watch at a crime scene unless framed.

choices.text: "Pehle mujhe murder ka exact time aur crime scene ki forensic report dikhao, phir main har sawaal ka jawab dunga."

memory: {{playerName}} asked to inspect the time-of-death and forensic report before answering further questions.
